# No additional properties in structured output

The Pydantic models set model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid"), so parsed extraction JSON must not contain any fields beyond those declared by the models.

Ensure strict validation of the structured extraction output and reject responses that include unexpected or extra properties.
